Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Berkshire Money Management Upped Holding by $350,700 as Shares Rose; Hamlin Capital Management Holding in Enterprise Prods Partners L (EPD) Has Lifted by $101.38 Million
June 20, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Berkshire Money Management Inc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 141.41% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Berkshire Money Management Inc bought 2,100 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3,585 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $601,000, up from 1,485 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Berkshire Money Management Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $917.50 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.9776 during the last trading session, reaching $186.6676. About 12.55 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Hamlin Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Enterprise Prods Partners L (EPD) by 116.85% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hamlin Capital Management Llc bought 4.22 million shares as the company’s stock rose 9.72% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 7.84 million shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $191.90M, up from 3.61M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hamlin Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Enterprise Prods Partners L for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $61.12B market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $28.13. About 1.64 million shares traded. Enterprise Products Partners L.P. (NYSE:EPD) has risen 4.65% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.92% the S&P500.
Berkshire Money Management Inc, which manages about $333.40 million and $400.55 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Ishares Tr (IWM) by 46,467 shares to 197,621 shares, valued at $30.01 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Tr (PFF) by 294,960 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 6,631 shares, and cut its stake in Ishares Tr (OEF).
